reviews_5s:
I would consider myself an extremely light funnel user- I'd say I probably use a funnel once every week at the most. That being said, I love this funnel set, I've personally only used the small funnel provided, but I'm a huge fan of the rubber on the sides to keep the funnel in place. Also it's super easy to wash. Build quality is also great, as with most OXO products that I have owned. Does exactly what you want it to do, but betterThese are really great funnels. They perform exactly as advertised. Easy to use and clean.As can be expected from the OXO Good Grips™ brand the plastic and rubber used are of pristine quality. The materials won't readily degrade or impart any detrimental materials into your critical accoutrements, and non-directly applied heat isn't a problem · Keep in mind that withstanding the quality of the thermo-plastic it still is plastic, so you may want a metal or glass strainer for highly acidic/corrosive fluids. The plastic is also of the white translucent assortment; making it a possibility that the funnels' material will stain from strong substances, think curries or tomato paste. I would recommend not letting such things accumulate or settle for an extensive length of time; which is not much of a challenge, they clean up easily. The funnels have three rubber strips on the outer surface that help them to pair with the rim of whatever vessel your using, I was able to pour plenty of liquid from a large container into the bigger sized funnel without supporting it, and the apparatus did not shift; the grip-strips do not penetrate through the plastic so no worries of your dry ingredients lodging on their tacky texture. The manufacturer's claim that the three ribs provide airflow to prevent splashing is double edged · Be careful using these with foaming soapy fluids it can build quickly inside your vessel and overflow. The tapered opening of either the large or small sizes (the small one does in fact have a comparatively narrower opening than the bigger one) are not appreciably wide; don't expect chunky, bulky or heavily viscous materials to pass through easily. Especially not if poured forcefully. There are three small notches inside each funnel that keep the accompanying strainer in place. The strainer itself is equipped with a central shaft to assist with removal from the funnel equipment. In conclusion, these funnels are suitable for most common household applications and should last a long while if cared for. Just don't expect them to be end-all be-all world-beaters.This is a great little funnel set! I really appreciate how all three pieces nest together, and there are little bump-outs that connect them in place. The strainer was especially handy and did a better job than I expected. The funnels do a great job with both powders and liquids, and are sturdy enough that they stay in place if you accidently get a little top-heavy. Highly recommend for the priceI really hate it when I'm decanting olive oil from the large economy-sized bottle to a smaller one when the funnel stops draining and the oil bubbles up and out of the top along with the air escaping from the little bottle! Such a mess! I found the thin black ribs around the outside of these funnels hold the spout just far enough from the bottle opening to allow air to flow out of the bottle as the oil goes in. No more messy countertops!

I have run these two funnels through the dishwasher several times already and they still look like new.

Haven't used the little strainer yet but think it will come in handy when making Thanksgiving gravy to strain out any lumps as I fill the gravy boats.

Excellent set of strainers that nest compactly! I'd buy these again.I needed someone to transfer peppercorns and bulk spices into smaller containers for use, and the smaller funnel is perfect, reducing waste from spillover from before. The larger funnel has also been used for transferring bulk liquids, etc. Both funnels are quite durable and just the right thickness. I do feel like I’m getting my money’s worth.First I will say that I have given these funnels a five star rating not because they are the greatest things in the world, but because they are the best funnels I have ever owned.

The advertising for these funnels that talks about the ribs that allow air to vent from the destination container is true, although they don't provide a LARGE amount of space between the funnel and the inside of what you are using for a destination. But the space they provide IS quite adequate for the purpose intended.

They balance well on the top of a destination container as they don't have a large handle on one side that would tend to weigh one side down. The small thumb-hold and the ribs for venting are made of a substance more like rubber than the plastic body of the funnels. Which makes them easier to handle. NO fumbling with THESE babies!

The outside of the funnels are a textured plastic which gives them the TINIEST bit more traction for handling them, while the inside of the funnels are VERY smooth and slick making for easier cleaning.

At first I was the tiniest bit confused about where the strainer was supposed to go or how it was supposed to work, and THEN discovered that in the larger of the two funnels are three small nubs that allow you to "snap" the strainer into place. These "nubs" are NOT present in the smaller unit. The strainer is very useful for straining the detritus of frying french fries from the oil they were fried in (or anything remotely similar that require a straining action) although the holes in the strainer are large enough that they allow SMALL particles to pass through. It would NOT work well for loose leaf tea ...

Dimensional measurements below were made with an electronic caliper and are approximate ... rounded to a single decimal point. ID = Inside Diameter, OD = Outside Diameter.

SMALL FUNNEL------------------------------LARGE FUNNEL
Large end OD: 4.2"----------------------------------4.5"
Small end (at the tip) OD: 0.5"---------------------0.7"
Small end (1" back from the tip) OD: 0.8"---------0.8"
Small end (at the tip) ID: 0.3"-----------------------0.4"
Length: 3.2"-------------------------------------------5.2"

Overall, I've got to say that I am extremely satisfied with these funnels, as I think that all aspects of what a funnel should be and do have been well thought out and executed. Anybody not satisfied with these funnels is just TOO picky to live ...When I began making kefir I looked at this OXO funnel/strainer and a nylon mesh strainer sold by Harold Import Co. Based on reviews, and a belief that the nylon strainer would be more versatile, I purchased the strainer set from Harold Imports and used them for some months.

While the strainers are indeed versatile, due to the fine mesh on the 3" strainer it also put an incredible strain on my patience. I was considering quitting kefir making due to the time and effort required, but figured I'd give this OXO set a shot before I gave up on kefir completely.

The large funnel with the strainer is a complete game changer! Now gravity often strains the kefir from the grains for me, or a few quick stirs with a spoon will strain my thicker batches. The kefir routine has gone from a 20 minute chore to a 5 minute (or less) activity. I'm guessing I save an hour or two each week, not to mention the stress and headache.

The rubber strips are highly functional, keeping the OXO secure while I fill the funnel and wait for it to drain. The design of the strainer is also excellent. It locks into place and unlocks easily, making cleaning quick and hassle free. The "locking tabs" may wear down over time, but so far I haven't had a problem with the strainer coming unlocked even during vigorous stirring of funnel contents.

If you're just getting started with kefir, or have been doing it the hard way for some time (as I did), I highly recommend purchasing this set and making life easy on yourself.

As an aside, the nyolon strainer set is incredibly useful for other tasks, I simply wouldn't recommend them for kefir.I bought this product on a recommendation from a reviewer who compared this product favorably over the normal nylon mesh strainers for kefir. I was not disappointed!

I had my doubts. The ribs you see in the pictures look like metal, and while you can use metal mesh strainers with kefir, I did not want to. These ribs are NOT metal, they just give enough of a gap to prevent vapor-lock (when the liquid stays in the funnel because air can’t get out of what you’re putting it into). The plastic filter disk is EXCELLENT. The holes are the perfect size to let the kefir through and keep the grains. It secures in place under three bumps on the inside of the funnel, with a distinct pop to let you know it is in place. The bumps do not contribute any difficulty during cleaning of the unit, and being able to disassemble and soak the whole thing if I want to isn’t necessary, but I can see some times that I would find that desirable.

This thing isn’t pricy. I’m glad I went with this for the first time around, and thank you to the Amazon reviewer who referred me to it. This made selection easier and I have no doubt it will outlast ten of those nylon mesh strainers, I hope this helps you too.I LOVE these funnels. Sure they help move substances from one larger location to a smaller space. But they were especially useful in pouring drinks and soups from carryout containers into glasses and bowls in our own home. During building games, several of them upside down next to each other make a perfect, decorative base for a flat piece to start the second story of a construction. The large one served as a model of a face to choose which mask to wear when I went out, kind of like a dress form is to a seamstress. I also popped the large one on my head, secured it in place and pretended to be the Tin Woodsman and I walked around the house singing, "If I Only Had A Brain." Ah, great memories. Sometimes, my little dog would wear one and we played tin woodsman together (although I don't think she quite got the whole concept, but she was sweet about it.) I used both the large and the small in my windows to prop up Teddy Bears for my neighborhood's Bear Hunt. I used the larger one as a megaphone when calling my daughter while she was outside. It wasn't that loud, actually, but it did make us both laugh and that was a wonderful thing. I will be indebted to OXO and their funnels forever.
